note: Seed catalog. Every row is a claimed failure mode with a detection recipe; none has been swept against a live site yet. A row graduates to evidenceStatus 'measured' only after a sweep reproduces it on a live install, verifies the detection recipe catches it, and records the result. SKIPPED and INCONCLUSIVE sweeps are never folded into pass rates.

failureModes.title: config:import exits 0 but the site serves the old config
failureModes.symptom: drush config:import or config:set reports success; a page or form still behaves per the previous configuration.
failureModes.rootCause: Config consumers cache parsed values outside the config factory, or the import did not invalidate the cache tags the affected output depends on.
failureModes.detection: After any config write, read back with get_site_config (state), then probe an affected URL with verify_page. A match on config:get alone is not evidence of delivery.
failureModes.citation: mosaic-headless 'never trust the commit' pattern, adapted

failureModes.title: hook_update_N returns early and reports success
failureModes.symptom: The update hook shows as applied; the intended data change did not happen.
failureModes.rootCause: Early-return paths (dependency guards, conditional skips) return without doing work; drush updb reports success either way.
failureModes.detection: After updb, assert the intended data state via state-plane reads (entity counts, field values), never via the update log.

failureModes.title: Custom plugin class parses cleanly but is never discovered
failureModes.symptom: No error anywhere; the plugin's behavior is simply absent.
failureModes.rootCause: Wrong namespace/file location relative to the module's src/ tree, or missing/incorrect Drupal attribute — discovery is convention-driven, not loader-driven.
failureModes.detection: Consult the knowledge plane (discovery docs) before writing; probe the discovered plugin list via the state plane after. Both, not either.

failureModes.title: Wrong service/interface injection fatals only on the page that uses it
failureModes.symptom: Site builds and most pages work; one route returns the critical-error screen.
failureModes.rootCause: Autowiring and interface mismatches resolve only at first instantiation on the affected route.
failureModes.detection: verify_page every route the change touches; a 5xx or the critical-error marker is a dead page even when the commit reported success.

failureModes.title: Right content, wrong freshness, no error ever
failureModes.symptom: Updated content does not appear on lists or views that cache by tag.
failureModes.rootCause: The render array lacks the entity's cache tag (or a required cache context), so invalidation never reaches it.
failureModes.detection: After content writes, verify_page the listing URL and compare a marker string; absence with correct backend state implicates cache metadata.

failureModes.title: The page is dead but the HTTP status does not say so
failureModes.symptom: Public page returns a very small body or an error screen under a 200/3xx, or a 5xx with a large HTML wrapper.
failureModes.rootCause: Drupal's critical-error handling and proxy layers can produce non-5xx responses for dead pages.
failureModes.detection: verify_page treats 5xx as dead, matches the critical-error marker, and flags 200s under 64 bytes as suspicious_short.
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev sweep 2026-10-16: induced sitewide 500 (global-styling css-category bad patch) -> 200-response replaced by 500/2527B; verify_page flagged server_error through the planes. Thresholds (5xx=dead, marker=dead, <64B-200=suspicious) re-measured. see sweep/records/2026-10-16-fm-critical-error-page.json

failureModes.title: Custom render code dereferences an optional field and fatals the whole site
failureModes.symptom: Every full-page render returns 500 after creating a node whose optional field is empty; every page, not just the new one.
failureModes.rootCause: Preprocess hooks / event subscribers do field_page_type->referencedEntities()[0]->getName() without an empty check; null propagates into the render pipeline sitewide.
failureModes.detection: verify_page on the new URL immediately after creation: server_error at 200-commit. Reproduced 3x in usagov_benefit_category_search (hook + subscriber).
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev bring-up 2026-09-26: nodes nids 11-15, verify_page server_error 2090-2229B, watchdog Call to a member function getName() on null. Re-proven mechanically 2026-10-16 (sweep/records/2026-10-16-fm-unpopulated-field-fatal.json, unpatch mode SWEEP_FM_UNPATCH=1). Fixture drift noted 2026-10-16: field_page_type is now REQUIRED on basic_page and content_moderation drafts fresh nodes (anonymous gets 403), so the reproduction trigger is now render-path-shaped — any published basic_page with an empty field (all five rebuilt pages qualify) fatals sitewide under the unguarded code; same symptom, 500/2090B reproduced exactly.

failureModes.title: A libraries.yml CSS entry without a category 500s every page that loads it
failureModes.symptom: HTTP 500 with AssertionError: Invalid CSS category, sitewide.
failureModes.rootCause: Drupal 9.5+ requires CSS assets under css: {base|theme|component|smart_admin}:. The usagov carousel library listed css/slick.min.css: {} bare.
failureModes.detection: verify_page: server_error despite successful theme install and config import.
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev bring-up 2026-09-26: homepage HTTP 500/3745B before fix, 200/16.7KB after

failureModes.title: site:install --existing-config crashes on cross-module event-class references
failureModes.symptom: Install aborts with Class X not found in getSubscribedEvents() for a module that is not even the one being enabled.
failureModes.rootCause: ModuleInstaller rebuilds the kernel after EACH module enable; nothing declares cross-module dependencies, so subscribers compile before the module providing their event class is loadable.
failureModes.detection: Reproduced 4x from clean DBs. Guard getSubscribedEvents with class_exists; the events register correctly after the full batch.
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev bring-up 2026-09-26: install crashed mid-config-import; 5 local patches then let it complete. Mechanically re-proven 2026-10-16 on the usagov-sweep-scratch scratch project (sweep/records/2026-10-16-fm-install-order-subscriber-crash.json): fresh site:install minimal --existing-config crashes at container compile — The service Drupal/usagov_benefit_finder_api/Controller/LifeEventController has a dependency on a non-existent service file.repository. Detect recipe (get_site_status + verify_page) caught the half-installed state through the planes.

failureModes.title: A failed module enable leaves the module half-registered and bricks every drush command
failureModes.symptom: After one failed pm:enable, every drush command fatals with the same Class not found; the site is unbootstrappable.
failureModes.rootCause: ModuleInstaller writes module.<name> to core.extension BEFORE the container rebuild, so a compile failure leaves the module enabled but never installed.
failureModes.detection: Direct DB repair: remove the module row from the config table core.extension blob (scripts/agent-planes/repair-core-extension.php).
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev bring-up 2026-09-26: repaired via PDO repair script, bootstrap restored. Mechanically re-proven 2026-10-16 (sweep/records/2026-10-16-fm-half-install-state.json) with a stub module whose service references a non-existent dependency: pm:enable fatals at container compile, the repair recipe (repair-core-extension.php via ddev exec php — NOT drush php:script, which cannot bootstrap a bricked site) unbricks, verified by DEEP recovery check (get_site_status AND list_site_modules; get_site_status alone reported recovered on a broken module handler). Recipe flavor note: the repair targets modules half-committed in core.extension; the config-import crash variant leaves a bare-skeleton core.extension and needs dependency-safe re-provisioning instead.

failureModes.title: A services.yml injecting a core service that the profile never enabled
failureModes.symptom: pm:enable fails: dependency on non-existent service file.repository — on a site whose config lists the file module.
failureModes.rootCause: usagov_benefit_finder_api hardcodes @file.repository; the minimal profile does not enable file, and no dependency is declared. GSA never hits it because they import a full DB.
failureModes.detection: Drupal::hasService(file.repository) === false on a clean minimal install; enabling file first resolves it.
failureModes.citation: usagov-2021 ddev bring-up 2026-09-26: clean minimal install, hasService false, enable-order fix. Mechanically re-proven 2026-10-16 (sweep/records/2026-10-16-fm-undeclared-service-dependency.json): pm:enable of a module with an undeclared service dependency fatals at container compile naming the missing service, and the enable HALF-COMMITS — the module remains in core.extension after the failed command, and the next drush cr fatals naming the missing service (the hazard the detection recipe checks). Same root cause as the install-order crash.
